description: `get`/`set` methods used with property syntax. A getter without a setter is typed as `readonly`.
A property or method on the class itself, shared by all instances and accessed as `ClassName.member`.
`static { ... }` runs once when the class is defined, with access to private static members.
`private constructor()` forbids `new` outside the class, forcing callers through static factories.
`accessor name = value` generates a private backing field with a getter and setter (TS 4.9+).
